# Polynomial Interpolation

![Polynomial Interpolation function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/interpolation/11-polynomial_interpolation.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Interpolates or extrapolates the global polynomial through X/Y at one scalar query; returns a genuine interpolation error estimate distinct from the I32 diagnostic. Real DBL vectors/matrices; explicit real numeric promotion, no complex-to-real conversion, scalar lifting or broadcasting. PP uses ascending local powers as an explicit GS convention. Available variants: default.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

</details>
